data.title: Vehicle registration appointment, 7 March 2026
data.summary: The Kreis Beispielförde registration office (Zulassungsstelle) confirms your Saturday-service appointment to transfer a vehicle registration on 7 March 2026 at 10:00, counter 2. The fee is about €37.60.
data.explanation: This confirms your appointment at the vehicle registration office for a vehicle re-registration (Umschreibung). Bring registration certificates Part I and II (Zulassungsbescheinigung), the insurance's eVB number, a SEPA mandate for the vehicle tax (Kfz-Steuer) and your ID card. Expect a fee of about €37.60. If you can't attend, contact the office by phone or email shown on the letter.
